title: Juicy Jamaican Falafel Pancake
description: A fermented, juicy, monsoon-inspired dish featuring falafel wrapped in a light pancake batter for a unique gluten-free treat.

ingredients.name: Sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: for coating the falafel and topping

ingredients.name: Fermented chickpeas (Falafel)
ingredients.notes: ensure they are soft and ready to eat

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Mix all-purpose flour, coconut milk, sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl until smooth.
Dissolve 1 tablespoon of canola oil into the mixture. The remaining oil will be used for frying the falafel.
Fold in the fermented chickpeas gently to coat evenly.
Using a ladle, pour about 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides, flipping halfway through cooking time (about 2 minutes per side).
Remove the falafel from the skillet and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Meanwhile, preheat your pan or a non-stick griddle over medium heat. Scoop about 1/4 cup of batter into each pancake mold and cook until golden brown on both sides (about 2 minutes).
Fold the falafel into the pancakes and serve warm with additional coconut milk for dipping if desired.
Garnish with sesame seeds, black pepper, and any other preferred herbs or spices to enhance the flavor.
